incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Taiwan Company Act (公司法), 2018 consolidated revision, Articles 2(1)(iv), 128–135, 192, 201 and 387–394 (registration and correction procedure); Regulations Governing Permission of Investment in Taiwan from the Mainland Area (大陸地區人民來臺投資許可辦法) Articles 4, 6 and 8; Act Governing Relations between the People of the Taiwan Area and the Mainland Area (兩岸人民關係條例) Article 73; Company Registration Fee Charging Standards (公司登記規費收費準則) Article 2.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Investment Commission (經濟部投資審議委員會) for mainland-origin capital approval; Ministry of Economic Affairs, Administration of Commerce (經濟部商業發展署) for incorporation registration via the One-Stop Online Application Portal (公司與商業一站式線上申請作業).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (公司章程) and Application for Company Incorporation Registration (股份有限公司設立登記申請書), accompanied by the CPA capital verification report (資本額查核報告書) and the Mainland Investment Approval Certificate (大陸地區來臺投資許可函).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-in capital applies to a Taiwan company limited by shares since the 2018 amendment; the subscribed capital must be remitted from the mainland China investor into the company's pre-incorporation bank account (籌備處帳戶) in Taiwan and verified by a licensed CPA through a capital verification report before filing. No escrow account is statutorily mandated; however, the MOEA Investment Commission will assess capital adequacy relative to the aircraft engine leasing plan and may request a higher paid-in amount in the mainland investment permit.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration of the People's Republic of China (国家税务总局; SAT) via the National Unified Electronic Tax Bureau (全国统一规范电子税务局) at https://etax.chinatax.gov.cn and taxpayer hotline 12366; export-rebate clearance is administered jointly with the General Administration of Customs through the China International Trade Single Window (中国国际贸易单一窗口). Sub-national tax distinctions (urban maintenance and construction tax, education surcharges, and local levies) are administered by provincial and municipal tax bureaus under the SAT's vertical leadership.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign investor incorporates the WFOE with the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR). The SAMR business license carries the 18-digit Unified Social Credit Code (统一社会信用代码, USCC), which is the statutory TIN and VAT ID for all tax, customs, and foreign exchange filings. Tax registration is effected automatically through inter-agency data sharing within 30 days of incorporation; the WFOE must then complete the supplementary taxpayer information return, appoint a tax officer, and apply for invoice quotas and general VAT taxpayer qualification when applicable. Non-resident foreign enterprises without a permanent establishment in mainland China do not obtain a separate VAT ID; the domestic payer or recipient is registered as a withholding agent, and a foreign enterprise that becomes directly taxable may obtain a temporary tax registration code (临时税务登记) from the competent local tax authority.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation (PRC resident enterprise subject to Enterprise Income Tax at the statutory 25% rate on worldwide income; no pass-through eligibility for an LLC-type WFOE; dividends distributed to the foreign parent are generally exposed to 10% dividend withholding tax, subject to treaty relief and reinvestment deferral).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Available elections include: (a) election to register as a general VAT taxpayer before reaching the mandatory RMB 5,000,000 turnover threshold, thereby allowing input-VAT credits; (b) election between the export 'exemption and refund' method and the 'exemption, credit and refund' method for VAT rebates, in accordance with exporter type; (c) small-scale taxpayer election to apply the temporarily reduced 1% VAT levy in lieu of 3% (policy in force through 31 December 2027); and (d) election by a non-resident investor under Caishui 2018 No. 102 to defer dividend withholding on reinvested retained earnings of the WFOE. There is no check-the-box or other elective entity-classification regime under PRC tax law for limited-liability companies; hybrid mismatch outcomes are countered by the statutory General Anti-Avoidance Rule, thin-capitalisation, and controlled-foreign-enterprise provisions rather than elective mechanisms.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: PRC Value-Added Tax (VAT; 增值税) — an invoice-credit, destination-principle consumption tax administered under the VAT Law of the People's Republic of China (adopted 25 December 2024, effective 1 January 2026) together with Circular Caishui 2016 No. 36 and the cross-border taxable services regime of Announcement 2016 No. 29.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Annual aggregate taxable turnover exceeding RMB 5,000,000 makes registration as a general VAT taxpayer compulsory. Below that threshold the entity may remain a small-scale taxpayer (simplified levy at 3%, temporarily reduced to 1% until 31 December 2027), and small-scale taxpayers with monthly sales up to RMB 100,000 (quarterly up to RMB 300,000) are currently VAT-exempt. Dry leasing of aircraft engines to domestic lessees is a taxable supply of tangible-movable-property leasing services taxed at 13%; cross-border leases are zero-rated and therefore do not trigger the threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Full-digital electronic invoicing is mandatory nationwide under the Golden Tax System IV (金税四期). All VAT invoices must be created in the National Electronic Invoice Service Platform, each carrying a nationally unified invoice number, an embedded QR verification code, and a digital seal; invoice data are cleared in near real time into the SAT central data pool. Large taxpayers are obliged to integrate their billing systems with the platform using standard open APIs, transmitting invoice metadata (seller/buyer USCC, amount, tax rate, and goods or service classification code) for online validation before an invoice number is released. Export invoices for physically exported goods must reference the customs export declaration number; cross-border zero-rated services require a specially flagged zero-rate e-invoice. The China International Trade Single Window effectuates real-time customs, inspection, and export-tax-rebate data clearance through a single electronic submission channel.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating (0% VAT with entitlement to input-VAT refund or rebate) is available on two bases. (a) Physical export of goods: aircraft engines sold by the WFOE and exported through a PRC customs port, supported by a customs export declaration and transportation out of the PRC customs territory. (b) Cross-border supply of tangible-movable-property leasing services: under the cross-border taxable services list (Caishui 2016 No. 36 and Announcement 2016 No. 29), a dry lease of an aircraft engine to an offshore lessee, including a lessee in Taiwan, qualifies only if the lessee is located outside mainland China, the engine and the leasing service are wholly consumed outside the PRC customs territory, and the lease agreement and foreign-payment evidence indubitably demonstrate the offshore character. Engines remaining registered in mainland China or used on domestic routes disqualify the lease from zero-rating, leaving the rental taxable at 13% with no refund entitlement.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (海关出口货物报关单) evidencing export of the aircraft engine, or a customs-offsite confirmation for a services-only cross-border lease
Bill of Lading (or Airway Bill) demonstrating physical dispatch from a mainland China customs port to the overseas/Taiwan lessee, with vessel and voyage identifiers
Inward Remittance Certificate (银行收汇凭证) issued by the settlement bank proving receipt of the lease rental in freely convertible foreign exchange from abroad
Executed cross-border aircraft engine lease agreement specifying engine serial number, lease term, rental schedule, and offshore usage/return provisions
Offshore-consumption evidence, such as an overseas aircraft registry entry, lessee utilisation certificate, or independent inspection report confirming operations outside the PRC customs territory
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export zero-rating refunds are subject to pre-refund automated risk screening and post-refund administrative audit by the SAT export-rebate risk-control centre, with high-risk claims suspended pending verification. Fraudulent zero-rating claims (骗取出口退税) trigger mandatory retrospective clawback of the VAT refunded, late-payment surcharge, administrative fines of one to five times the tax defrauded under the Law of the PRC on the Administration of Tax Collection, downgrade of the taxpayer's credit rating to the lowest grade 'D' (entailing suspension of invoice facilitation and export-rebate priority for up to 36 months), and denial of further refund applications until all amounts are repaid. Recovery is time-barred at three years for ordinary understatements, five years in special circumstances, and is unlimited for fraudulent refunds and evasion. Criminal liability arises under Article 204 of the Criminal Law of the PRC for the crime of fraudulently obtaining export tax rebates, punishable with imprisonment up to life imprisonment and confiscation of property; responsible officers and beneficial owners may be jointly prosecuted. Reliance on forged bills of lading, false customs declarations, circular foreign-exchange arrangements, or sham offshore lessees is treated as presumptive fraud, and the burden of substantiating offshore consumption lies entirely with the WFOE.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual ordinary shareholders' meeting resolution adopting the annual business report, financial statements and earnings-distribution proposal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General meeting of shareholders (board-convened; approval recorded in the statutory minute book, no agency filing at this step)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Calendar-year entity: on or before June 30 of the following year (within six months of fiscal year-end, Companies Act Art. 170)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-convening exposes each responsible person to administrative fines under the Companies Act and blocks the MOEA final-accounts filing and tax-clearance certification.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No aircraft-lease-specific tax holiday. General incentives: R&D investment tax credits under the Statute for Industrial Innovation; small-profit enterprises with annual taxable net income not exceeding NTD 120,000 are exempt from regular CIT. Undistributed earnings are subject to an additional 5% retained earnings tax, making the aggregate effective burden 25% on profits retained beyond the following year.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Profit-Seeking Enterprise Income Tax Settlement Return (Income Tax Act Art. 71) electronically filed through the Ministry of Finance E-Filing Portal (taxweb.nat.gov.tw).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Calendar-year taxpayers must file between 1 May and 31 May of the following year. For an approved special fiscal year, the return is due within five months after the fiscal year-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross lease rental and service fee income from dry-leasing turbofan aircraft engines to Chinese and international airlines.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report only Taiwan-source revenue allocable to the WFOE. Rental from engines physically located outside Taiwan must be supported by invoices and customs/contractual evidence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 03 - Cost of Goods Sold and Depreciation
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Direct costs including engine acquisition cost, maintenance reserves, insurance, storage, and straight-line depreciation over the estimated useful life.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Capitalized engine costs must be depreciated in accordance with Taiwan depreciation rules; lease-in costs paid to an offshore related party require transfer pricing documentation and withholding on cross-border fees.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Interest income, foreign exchange gains/losses on lease receivables in USD or RMB, and guarantee fees.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Interest paid on shareholder loans to a non-resident parent must be separately disclosed; the 20% withholding tax applies unless thin capitalization or treaty provisions alter the deduction.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net operating loss deduction claimed under the 10-year carryforward rule.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Losses must be traceable to Taiwan books and records; a non-resident parent cannot apply foreign losses to the Taiwan WFOE's tax return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statutorily adjusted income after excluding exempt income and applying all tax adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a non-resident entity without a PE, taxable income is deemed to be 20% of total Taiwan-source revenue if books are not recognized by the tax authority.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 20% regular income tax on taxable net income, reduced by prepayments and investment tax credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the return shows no tax due because of carried-forward losses, attach loss utilization schedules and prior-year approved return copies.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Income Basic Tax on the basic income amount; excess of basic tax over regular tax is payable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Aircraft leasing may generate large tax-exempt components (foreign branch dividends, asset disposal gains); regardless of book treatment, include them in the AMT computation if above the NTD 500,000 deduction.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: 5% tax on unappropriated earnings remaining undistributed at the end of the following year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident parent's directive to keep profits in the WFOE will trigger this entity-level tax unless the China parent receives a formal dividend.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: 1% surcharge per month (or segment of a month) on the unpaid tax amount, up to a maximum of 10%. If the return is filed after a formal demand from the tax authority, a 3% surcharge plus an additional 1% monthly penalty applies up to 10%. Intentional failure to file permits a presumed assessment and an additional 100% penalty on the resulting underpayment.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 21% (final withholding tax on dividends distributed to a non-resident corporate shareholder)
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No bilateral tax treaty is currently in force between Taiwan and mainland China. The Cross-Strait Agreement on Avoidance of Double Taxation and Tax Cooperation (signed 25 August 2015) has not been ratified/implemented by the Taiwan Legislative Yuan; therefore, no treaty relief is available. If the agreement enters into force, reduced dividend WHT (5% for shareholding of at least 25% and meeting substance conditions; otherwise 10%) would apply only after the shareholder submits a Taiwan Tax Resident Certificate (TRC), an official beneficial ownership declaration, and supporting evidence of the direct shareholding structure to the NTB within the statutory claim period.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties paid to a non-resident related enterprise are generally subject to a 20% final withholding tax (reduced to 10% under the dormant Cross-Strait ADT if/when effective). Interest paid to a non-resident lender is also subject to 20% final withholding (10% under the ADT once effective). Where the payee is an offshore aircraft-engine lessor, characterization of a payment as rent versus royalty is critical: rent for the use of engines is operating lease income subject to 20% WHT, while payments for IP embedded in engine technology may be recharacterized as royalties at 20%.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File required when annual related-party controlled transactions equal or exceed NTD 30 million. Master File and Country-by-Country Report are required for multinational enterprise groups with consolidated group revenue of at least NTD 27 billion.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Taiwan applies a substance-over-form doctrine and statutory anti-avoidance rules (Income Tax Act Art. 66-8; Tax Collection Act Art. 12-1). For an aircraft-engine dry-leasing WFOE to be respected, the entity must maintain real commercial substance in Taiwan: permanent office or registered premises, locally resident management and technical staff, board meetings and strategic decisions in Taiwan, possession of engine operating records, exposure to and management of engine risk (lease default, maintenance, repossession), and a properly capitalized bank account. A pure contractual structure or a paper 'SPV' without commercial activities will be disregarded, and income will be re-allocated to the mainland Chinese parent under the IRIS (Inappropriate Realization of Income by Settlement in Foreign Exchange) principle.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Issuing or receiving fictitious invoices for engine lease rental to inflate deductible costs, creating phantom lessee contracts, or underreporting Taiwan-source lease income.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fraudulent tax evasion is punishable under Tax Collection Act Art. 41 with imprisonment for not less than six months and not more than five years, plus a fine of up to NTD 5,000,000. The tax authority will also collect the evaded tax with daily interest and impose a penalty of up to three times the underpaid tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who execute or approve false invoices are jointly and severally liable for unpaid taxes and penalties. A criminal court may impose travel restrictions, asset freezes, and, upon conviction, imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Lack of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating as a letter-box entity with no employees, no engine operating records, and no board meetings; all decisions and risk management are conducted by mainland Chinese parent personnel; the Taiwan entity merely signs agreements in exchange for a nominal margin.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The tax authority may disregard the Taiwan WFOE by invoking Art. 66-8 of the Income Tax Act, re-attribute the full lease income to the parent, levy 20% CIT on the deemed net profit, and impose a 30% penalty on the underpaid tax. The WFOE may also lose its license under the Foreign Investment Act.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The de facto director (whether Taiwanese or foreign) may be held personally liable for the re-attributed tax debt, barred from leaving Taiwan until the debt is settled, and subject to disqualification as a director for up to five years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Setting engine lease rentals, maintenance fees, or management charges below arm's length; failing to prepare a Local File and Master File despite controlled transactions exceeding the statutory threshold; submitting internally inconsistent benchmark analyses.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The tax authority will make a transfer pricing adjustment from the related-party transaction amount to the arm's length price. The resulting additional tax is assessed at 20%, and an administrative penalty of 30% of the underpaid tax applies. In cases of intentional misstatement, the penalty may reach 100%.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign the TP report or cause the filing of fraudulent documentation face personal fines, disqualification, and criminal liability for aiding tax evasion. In severe cases, a court order can attach personal bank accounts and impose a travel ban.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to deduct or withhold 21% WHT on dividends to the mainland Chinese parent; failing to withhold 20% WHT on interest, royalties, or offshore lease-in rents; classifying rental payments as 'cost reimbursements' to bypass withholding.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: A withholding agent who fails to withhold is required to pay the withheld tax itself. Additionally, a fine of one to three times the amount of withholding tax is imposed, along with daily interest. The payment to the non-resident is treated as a taxable distribution if not rectified.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are jointly and severally liable with the company for unpaid withholding tax and fines. A director's personal assets may be attached, and the director can be prohibited from leaving Taiwan while the tax debt remains outstanding.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Concealing the ultimate mainland Chinese ownership through layers of nominee shareholders and SPVs; failing to register beneficial owners with the Taiwan Company Registry; using cash or crypto receipts to circumvent bank settlement of lease payments.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Money Laundering Control Act and Company Act beneficial ownership rules, a legal entity can be fined up to NTD 5,000,000 per violation, and the responsible officer can be fined up to NTD 5,000,000. Failure to report a substantial controller triggers a fine of NTD 200,000 to NTD 500,000 per instance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be disqualified and banned from serving as directors for up to five years. In money laundering prosecutions, the court may impose imprisonment of up to five years, confiscation of the leased engines, and a travel ban pending trial.
